text: {"lessons":["A few months of gains or losses do not predict what prices will do next, so I should not trade based on recent movements.","Selling Stock A at a profit did not prevent my account from falling; I should judge each position by my goals, not just whether it is above my average cost.","Because losses bother me more than gains please me, I should avoid both panic-selling after a decline and holding a position just to avoid admitting a mistake."]}
